key.name: enable-minimize
key.description: Allow a four-finger swipe down to minimize the focused window.

key.name: enable-restore
key.description: Allow a four-finger swipe up to restore the most recently minimized window.

key.name: exclude-fullscreen
key.description: Do not minimize fullscreen windows and do not add them to the restore history. Disabled by default.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: WM class names of applications that Gestura must never minimize. Empty by default.

key.name: action-threshold
key.description: Distance in unaccelerated touchpad units a four-finger vertical swipe must travel before the configured action runs.
